run_moco_pretraining: run MoCo self-supervised pre-training on ImageNet with distributed data parallel across multiple GPUs
run_moco_vit_pretraining: run MoCo pre-training using ViT architecture with configurable stop-grad on first conv layer
resume_moco_checkpoint: resume MoCo training from a saved checkpoint file with optimizer and scaler state
adjust_learning_rate_cosine: adjust the optimizer learning rate using a warmup then half-cycle cosine decay schedule
adjust_moco_momentum_cosine: adjust the MoCo momentum encoder update coefficient with a half-cycle cosine schedule
